metadata.name: Stonewatch Keep
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A fortress walled across a mountain gorge on a night of storm. Co-op: sound the horn, hold the Deep Wall against the Black Warband on the causeway and the ladders, stop them when the culvert blows, then make the last stand in the keep until dawn. Team modes: the attackers camp in the valley, the defenders hold the keep (flags in the camp and the great hall; hills on the causeway, the wall, the bailey and the hall).

objectives.text: Sound the horn in the great hall to begin the siege
Stop them coming through the culvert
Fall back to the keep and hold until dawn

do.text: Torches are moving in the valley. Sound the horn in the great hall when the wall is manned.
The Warband is at the wall! Hold the causeway and throw down the ladders.
Sappers are creeping to the culvert with a charge!
The culvert is breached! They are coming up under the bailey!
Trolls on the causeway! The ram is coming up.
The culvert is choked with the dead.
The gate is broken! Fall back to the keep! Hold until dawn!
The portcullis chains snap. They are in the bailey!
Dawn breaks over the gorge. Riders on the ridge! The Warband breaks and runs.
